title: Secure AI Agents in Azure: AI Gateway, Tools, and Trust
description:
See how to secure AI agents in Azure with controls developers can use immediately. In this live demo, we’ll protect agent-to-tool and agent-to-API interactions using Azure API Management as an AI gateway, govern MCP tools and registries with API Center, enforce identity and secret hygiene with Entra ID and Key Vault, and add observability for tracing and audit. You’ll learn practical ways to reduce prompt injection, over-permissioned tools, data leakage, and unsafe agent behavior.

Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
